title: Investing in living better: Quality of life and the future of business
summary: The quality-of-life market is expanding rapidly beyond healthcare into all sectors, with executives projecting it could represent 9-15% of annual revenues by 2034, totaling $6.7-11.2 trillion in growth. Survey data shows 78% of C-suite executives are optimistic about QoL market growth, with 84% planning to launch QoL-related offerings within the next year, driven by consumer demand, advancing technology, and brand alignment. The market success hinges on addressing eight dimensions of quality of life—financial, physical, mental, social, spiritual, educational, occupational, and environmental—positioning QoL as a strategic priority across all industries.
central_argument: The quality-of-life market represents a multi-trillion-dollar strategic imperative for businesses across all sectors because it aligns with evolving consumer values while extending both lifespan and healthspan.
key_claims: The QoL market could represent 9-15% of annual sector revenues by 2034, totaling $6.7-11.2 trillion in market growth
Venture capital funding for digital health in the US grew fivefold between 2013 and 2023
78% of surveyed C-suite executives express enthusiasm for QoL market growth prospects
84% of companies plan to develop QoL-related offerings within the next year
90% of executives identify the QoL market as strategic priority within three years
Approximately 60% of buyers are willing to pay a premium for products promoting healthy living
67% of shoppers desire more well-being-focused product options
Nearly half of executives see QoL as opportunity to align with consumer expectations and enhance brand reputation
key_tensions: The article distinguishes between lifespan (years lived) and healthspan (quality of years), complicating traditional healthcare metrics that focus solely on longevity
The article positions QoL as moving beyond niche health sectors to become central across all industries, challenging the historical siloing of wellness in specialized sectors
key_entities: McKinsey Executive Quality of Life and Healthy Living Market Sentiment Survey (2024)
